hooks.name: Typecheck on save
hooks.description: Catch type errors the moment the agent saves TypeScript.

hooks.name: Core change needs its property
hooks.description: Keeps the pure core and its correctness properties in step.

action.prompt: A file in src/core changed. Check .kiro/specs/revenant/design.md 'Correctness Properties': if this change affects a property, update or add the matching fast-check test in test/*.prop.test.ts, then run npm test. Confirm the file still imports nothing outside src/core and uses no fetch, Date.now or globals.

hooks.name: Costume check
hooks.description: Every spooky element must encode state and stay accessible.

action.prompt: A web file changed. Review it against .kiro/steering/costume.md, including its Scenery rule. Elements inside .horizon are allowed when they follow the Scenery rule: ink only (#0b0d12 and #141b2d), aria-hidden, no verdict shape and no verdict colour. The one-time load assembly of .horizon (plain CSS animations, once per page load, nothing at opacity 0 in base CSS) is allowed. Flag any other horizon animation, and any horizon animation that repeats or can replay. Flag scenery that breaks that rule, and flag decoration outside the horizon that carries no meaning. Also check: verdict is never colour-only, prefers-reduced-motion is honoured, new controls are keyboard reachable. Fix violations; otherwise say nothing.
